Full/half, FF wire/echo distinction, literal/control, native no-op/local rejection, aliases, malformed binding and atomic capacity failure. Emitter and every external service are declared recording boundaries. UI/status/reset services remain listed rather than treated as reconstructed; no actual echo execution, physical keyboard or complete native dispatcher claim.

Actual child key request/callback code and guarded stacks; explicit scalar parent boundary. Exact16bit key, inherited/changed duplex, one callback per request, missing/duplicate/nonzero selector, typed errors, retry cleanup, unsolicited/closed/old capability rejection. Actual parent profile/UART/echo tested separately.

Actual DOS BIOS keys during ASPECT WAITFOR, shared selected parent profile bindings, child-owned UART and real renderer echo. No physical modem or full local-key/UI/macro claim.

Exhaustive actual product reader CPU replay and8086 DOS execution in standard/enhanced modes with declared BIOS models. Both preserve occupiedAX0 versus emptyZF, read consumption and native normalization. CPU checks256 BDA flag patterns; DOS checks native WHEN state, disabled/deferred keyboard, file-reset retention and cancellation. No physical BIOS or full keyboard/UI dispatch claim.

Actual production interpreter automatically compiles ASP/missing-ASX with original namespace/old-ASX rules, preserves chain state, caller PSP/INT0/23/24 and files, survives a foreign-DS compiler CPU fault and a leaked INT0 vector, cancels before/after compiler EXEC, and completes20 counted real compiler replacements in one invocation. UART/renderer/BBS composition remains separately required.

Actual production nested DOS compiler and8086 ASPECT UART IRQ across N/S/H/B flow. Checked proactive XOFF/XON for S/B, raw IRQ reception, retained numeric/BREAK state, native compiled bytecode, exact unread ASIO return, vectors/PIC/MCR/guards. No resident-renderer, physical modem or external BBS claim.
